extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Add-ons page in the settings, holding the JellyStat and Engage settings that used to sit on the Home Screen page. A help panel under the settings pages says what the focused setting does and where on screen it shows. Coming up can end each run of back to back Engage slots with an Ends At line giving when the run finishes. Each Engage slot can turn its line off. Coming up can scroll: focus the list and press Down to go on through the week a day at a time; it goes back to the top when you move away. Needs Engage 1.11.8 for the Ends At line and the full week.
